title: Settings

account.websiteLogin: Pages you open from the app sign you in to soberhelpline.com (and, in Spanish, ayudasobria.com) automatically. To sign in there directly, use “Forgot password?” on that site to set a website password.

privacy.shareCheckInsDesc: Your assigned coach can see your daily check-ins and tracker entries. You can turn this off at any time.
privacy.updateErrorBody: We couldn't save that privacy change. Your previous setting is still active. Please try again.

notifications.dailyNudgeBody: How are you doing today? Take a moment to check in.
dailyNudgeBodies: How are you doing today? Take a moment to check in.
A quick check-in keeps your streak — and your clarity — going.
90 seconds for yourself. How's your heart today?
You showed up yesterday. Show up for you again today.
Notice how you're feeling before the day takes over.
One small moment of honesty with yourself. Ready?
Your check-in is waiting whenever you are.
notifications.reminderDesc: Choose a time to enable daily check-in reminders. Personal reminders have separate controls.
notifications.weekReviewBody: You showed up this week. Open the app to see your check-ins, mood arc, and boundaries held.
notifications.practiceDesc: Receive an occasional, clearly labeled practice call. Tap it, answer when ready, and the AI will open a realistic conversation.
notifications.practicePrivacy: Notifications never include names, family details, or conversation content. You can decline any call without penalty.
notifications.practicePermissionBody: Allow notifications for Sober Helpline in your device settings, then try again. Practice calls stay off until permission and token registration succeed.
notifications.practiceSaveErrorBody: We couldn't save that setting. Your previous setting is still active. Please try again.
notifications.practiceLoadError: We couldn't load your practice-call settings. Nothing was changed.
notifications.dailyErrorBody: Check notification permission in device Settings and retry. No reminder delivery is guaranteed.
notifications.familyCallDesc: Reminders for The Family Squares, our free family support call on Zoom (Mondays, 7:00 PM Pacific): an hour before and again 15 minutes before if you've saved your spot, or 30 minutes before if you haven't, plus a short note the next morning after a call you saved a spot for or joined.
notifications.familyCallErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.

membership.premiumFeatures: Everything in Essential · plan review included · private video requests, subject to scheduling
membership.essentialFeatures: Coach messaging · live groups · practice tools
membership.websiteSource: Your membership is through our website (soberhelpline.com or ayudasobria.com) — manage billing there.
membership.websiteAlsoSource: You also have a membership through our website (soberhelpline.com or ayudasobria.com). It is billed there separately — cancel it there if you no longer need it.
membership.websiteMemberHint: Already a member on soberhelpline.com? Your membership follows your email address. Sign in here with the same email you used on the website.
membership.websiteMemberHintWithEmail: Already a member on soberhelpline.com? Your membership follows your email address. Sign in here with the same email you used on the website. You are signed in as {{email}}.
membership.restoreActiveBody: Your membership was found and is active on this account.
membership.restoreNoneBody: We couldn't find any previous purchases for this Apple ID.
membership.restoreErrorBody: Something went wrong restoring your purchases. Please try again.
membership.attachedStoreNote: Your provider covers your access. If you also subscribed through the App Store or Google Play, cancel it here so you are not charged twice.

review.title: Rate Sober Helpline
review.body: Your App Store rating helps another family find support when they need it.
review.unavailableBody: We couldn't open the App Store right now. Please try again later.

signOutErrorBody: We couldn't remove this device from private notifications. Check your connection and try again.

signOutOffline.title: No connection right now
signOutOffline.body: We can't reach the server, so this device can't be removed from notifications yet. You can still sign out on this device: your signed-in details here will be erased, and notifications for this account will be turned off for this device the next time you sign in with a connection.
signOutOffline.bodyWithQueue: We can't reach the server, so this device can't be removed from notifications yet. You can still sign out on this device: your signed-in details here will be erased, and {{checkins}} unsent check-in(s) and {{notes}} unsent journal note(s) waiting to sync will be discarded. Notifications for this account will be turned off for this device the next time you sign in with a connection.

deleteAccount.confirmMessage: Your data will be permanently deleted within 30 days. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.subscriptionNote: Deleting your account does not cancel an App Store subscription. Cancel it first in your Apple ID subscriptions so you aren't charged again.
deleteAccount.subscriptionNoteWeb: Deleting your account does not cancel a membership you bought on our website. Cancel it there first so you aren't charged again.
deleteAccount.errorMessage: We couldn't delete your account. You are still signed in and no deletion was completed. Please try again.
deleteAccount.cleanupErrorMessage: Your account was deleted, but this device couldn't finish signing out. Close and reopen the app to clear the old session.

personalReminders.title: Personal reminders
personalReminders.body: Choose a discreet reminder for your own next step. Optional, easy to pause, and saved on this device.
personalReminders.cleanupTitle: Reminder cleanup could not be confirmed
personalReminders.cleanupBody: You are still signed in. Retry before signing out or deleting your account. You can disable notifications in your device Settings.

bereavement.body: If your loved one has died, you can tell us here. The app will stop asking about them and stop sending notes about their recovery.
bereavement.bereavedBody: You told us your loved one died. We're so sorry. The app no longer asks about them or sends notes about their recovery.
bereavement.undoBody: The app will ask about your loved one again and send notes about their recovery.
bereavement.errorBody: Please check your connection and try again.
bereavement.remindersDesc: Turn off to pause every reminder and note for as long as you need. Messages from Matt, a coach, or your family, and sessions you've booked, still come through.
bereavement.quietFailed: Your loved one's death is saved, but reminders weren't paused. Use the switch below to try again.
